info.text:
You pay about $120 an hour. Your plumber gets about $30.
The median wage for plumbers was $30.67/hr in May 2025 (BLS). Master plumbers bill about $120/hr on average (Angi).
Benefits push the true labor cost to about $44/hr, and unbilled drive time makes it about $58 per billed hour.
The rest covers the truck, tools, insurance, licenses, office and profit. Parts are usually extra.
Sources: BLS, Angi.
News and education, not financial advice.
